instruction: Find instructions on setting up automatic indentation in Vim, and apply the configuration to my system.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

result.command: if [ -f ~/.vimrc ]; then grep -E '^[[:space:]]*(set[[:space:]]+(autoindent|ai)|syntax[[:space:]]+on)' ~/.vimrc && echo 'AUTOINDENT_CONFIGURED' || echo 'AUTOINDENT_NOT_FOUND'; else echo 'VIMRC_NOT_FOUND'; fi

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling auto-indentation in Vim configuration file (.vimrc). Similar to original task requiring line number configuration, this variation requires searching online and applying 'set autoindent' or 'set ai' setting. The evaluator checks .vimrc directly using grep to verify autoindent is configured.
metadata.similarity_note: Generated task maintains identical difficulty and pattern to original - requires online search, understanding Vim configuration, and editing .vimrc file. Only difference is the specific setting being configured (auto-indentation vs line numbers).
